items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. This flaw, codenamed StyleSmuggler by Sansec, was actively exploited in the wild and patched with an emergency hotfix.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the updates promptly.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain elevated access to sensitive resources, leading to customer account takeover. This vulnerability was included in APSB26-92 and added to the CISA KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. It encompasses CVE-2026-71362 and other high-severity issues.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges. This was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges. This was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. This vulnerability requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges and was addressed in APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization affecting Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability specifically affecting Adobe Commerce B2B, which could enable a security-feature bypass. This was addressed as part of APSB26-92.
